speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A great man is dead, from the sound of you on the stair. Did he make a good end?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was told he died this day at the Savoy. I was not told the manner of the end.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the manner is not yours to invent at my table.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I take a candle up?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One candle. I have one line to write, and then I am done.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Write the line. Do not write a grief you do not have. The house can be sorry for a house without your pretending to more.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not pretending. The line is for Heminges, and it is short.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will leave the candle and come down. I do not read what you write.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Down when it is done, Master Shakespeare. Supper is not a vigil.
